parameters.description: [optional] If True the find text has special search operators (default = False)

parameters.name: $bMatchSoundsLike
parameters.description: [optional] If True finds words that sound similar to the find text (default = False)

parameters.name: $bMatchAllWordForms
parameters.description:
[optional] If True finds all forms of the find text
(e.g. "sit" locates "sitting" and "sat") (default = False)

parameters.name: $bFormat
parameters.description: [optional] True to have the find operation locate formatting in addition to or instead of the find text (default = False)

_word_docfind.returnValue:
- Success: a range object for the found text.
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oDoc is not an object
2 - $vSearchRange is not an object
3 - $oFindRange is not an object
4 - $sFindText could not be found. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_docfindreplace.name: _Word_DocFindReplace
_word_docfindreplace.signature: _Word_DocFindReplace ( $oDoc [, $sFindText = "" [, $sReplaceWith = "" [, $iReplace = $WdReplaceAll [, $vSearchRange = 0 [, $bMatchCase = False [, $bMatchWholeWord = False [, $bMatchWildcards = False [, $bMatchSoundsLike = False [, $bMatchAllWordForms = False [, $bForward = True [, $iWrap = $WdFindContinue [, $bFormat = False]]]]]]]]]]]] )
_word_docfindreplace.summary: Runs the specified find and replace operation

parameters.name: $oDoc
parameters.description: Word document object

parameters.name: $sFindText
parameters.description:
[optional] The text to be searched for. Use an empty string ("") to search for formatting only.
You can search for special characters by specifying appropriate character codes.
For example, "^p" corresponds to a paragraph mark and "^t" corresponds to a tab character (default = "")

parameters.name: $sReplaceWith
parameters.description:
[optional] The replacement text. To delete found text use an empty string ("").
You specify special characters and advanced search criteria just as you do for the Find argument (default = "")

parameters.name: $iReplace
parameters.description:
[optional] How many replacements are to be made: one, all, or none.
Can be anyWdReplace constant (default = $WdReplaceAll)

parameters.name: $vSearchRange
parameters.description:
[optional] Specifies the selection or range to search. Can be:
-1 - Specifies the current selection
0 - Specifies the entire document (default)
Any Word range object.

parameters.name: $bMatchCase
parameters.description: [optional] If True the find is case sensitive (default = False)

parameters.name: $bMatchWholeWord
parameters.description: [optional] If True only find entire words (default = False)

parameters.name: $bMatchWildcards
parameters.description: [optional] If True the find text has special search operators (default = False)

parameters.name: $bMatchSoundsLike
parameters.description: [optional] If True finds words that sound similar to the find text (default = False)

parameters.name: $bMatchAllWordForms
parameters.description:
[optional] If True finds all forms of the find text
(e.g. "sit" locates "sitting" and "sat") (default = False)

parameters.name: $bForward
parameters.description: [optional] True to search forward (toward the end of the document) (default = True)

parameters.name: $iWrap
parameters.description:
[optional] True wraps when the bottom or top of the document, selection or range is reached.
Can be one of the WdFindWrap constants (default = $WdFindContinue)

parameters.name: $bFormat
parameters.description: [optional] True to have the find operation locate formatting in addition to or instead of the find text (default = False)

_word_docfindreplace.returnValue:
- Success: 1.
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oDoc is not an object
2 - $vSearchRange is not an object
3 - An error occurred when the replace operation was executed. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_docget.name: _Word_DocGet
_word_docget.summary: Returns a collection object containing all documents or an object for a single document

parameters.name: $oAppl
parameters.description: Word object returned by a preceding call to _Word_Create()

parameters.name: $vIndex
parameters.description:
[optional] Specifies what to return:
-1 - Returns a collection of all documents (default)
0 - Returns the active document
n - The index number of the document to return (1 based)
x - The name of the document to return

_word_docget.returnValue:
- Success: a variable pointing to the collection of documents or a single document object.
@extended is set to the total number of documents
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oAppl is not an object
2 - $vIndex is invalid (< -1 or > Documents.Count)
3 - Specified document could not be found or error occurred. @extended is set to the COM error code
4 - Error returned when accessing the Documents collection. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_doclinkadd.name: _Word_DocLinkAdd
_word_doclinkadd.signature: _Word_DocLinkAdd ( $oDoc [, $oAnchor = Default [, $sAddress = Default [, $sSubAddress = Default [, $sScreenTip = Default [, $sTextToDisplay = Default [, $sTarget = Default]]]]]] )
_word_doclinkadd.summary: Adds a hyperlink to the document

parameters.name: $oDoc
parameters.description: Word document object

parameters.name: $oAnchor
parameters.description:
[optional] Range object for the text or graphic to be turned into a hyperlink
(default = Use entire document as range)

parameters.name: $sAddress
parameters.description:
[optional] The address for the specified link.
The address can be an E-mail address, an Internet address or a file name (default = link to the specified document is used)

parameters.name: $sSubAddress
parameters.description:
[optional] The name of a location within the destination file, such as a bookmark, named range
or slide number (default = None)

parameters.name: $sScreenTip
parameters.description:
[optional] The text that appears as a ScreenTip when the mouse pointer is positioned over the
specified hyperlink (default = Uses value of $sAddress)

parameters.name: $sTextToDisplay
parameters.description:
[optional] The display text of the specified hyperlink.
The value of this argument replaces the text or graphic specified by $oAnchor (default = Uses value of $sAddress)

parameters.name: $sTarget
parameters.description: [optional] The name of the frame or window in which you want to load the specified hyperlink

_word_doclinkadd.returnValue:
- Success: 1.
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oDoc is not an object
2 - Error occurred when adding the link. @extended is set to the COM error code
3 - $oAnchor is not 0 but is not a range object

_word_doclinkget.name: _Word_DocLinkGet
_word_doclinkget.summary: Returns a collection object containing all links in the document or a single link object

parameters.name: $oDoc
parameters.description: Word document object

parameters.name: $iIndex
parameters.description:
[optional] Specifies what to return:
Default - Returns a collection of all links (default)
n - The index number of the link to return (1 based)

_word_doclinkget.returnValue:
- Success: a variable pointing to the collection of links or a single link object.
@extended is set to the total number of links
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oDoc is not an object
2 - $iIndex is invalid (must be an integer > 0 and <= Hyperlinks.Count) or the keyword Default
3 - Error occurred when accessing the Hyperlinks collection. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_docopen.name: _Word_DocOpen

parameters.name: $oAppl
parameters.description: Word object returned by a preceding call to _Word_Create()

parameters.name: $sFilePath
parameters.description: The name or full path of the document to open

parameters.name: $bConfirmConversions
parameters.description: [optional] True displays the Convert File dialog if the file isn't in Word format (default = False)

parameters.name: $iFormat
parameters.description:
[optional] Specifies the format to use when opening the document.
Can be any of the WdOpenFormat enumeration (default = $WdOpenFormatAuto = the existing format)

parameters.name: $bReadOnly
parameters.description:
[optional] True to open the document as read-only (default = False).
Note: This argument doesn't override the read-only recommended setting on a saved document.

parameters.name: $bRevert
parameters.description:
[optional] Controls what happens if $sFilePath is the name of an open document.
True to discard any unsaved changes to the open document and reopen the file.
False to activate the open document (default = False)

parameters.name: $bAddToRecentFiles
parameters.description: [optional] True adds the file name to the list of recently used files at the bottom of the File menu (default = False)

parameters.name: $sOpenPassword
parameters.description: [optional] The password for opening the document

parameters.name: $sWritePassword
parameters.description: [optional] The password for saving changes to the document

_word_docopen.returnValue:
- Success: a variable pointing to the document object. @extended is set to 1 if $bReadOnly = False but read-write access could not be granted. Please see the Remarks section for details.
- Failure: sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oAppl is not an object
2 - The specified document does not exist
3 - Error occurred when opening specified document. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_docpictureadd.name: _Word_DocPictureAdd
_word_docpictureadd.summary: Adds a picture to the document

parameters.name: $oDoc
parameters.description: Word document object

parameters.name: $sFilePath
parameters.description: The path and file name of the picture

parameters.name: $bLinkToFile
parameters.description:
[optional] Specifies whether to link the picture to the file from which it was created.
True - Link the picture to the file from which it was created
False - Make the picture an independent copy of the file (default)

parameters.name: $bSaveWithDocument
parameters.description:
[optional] Specifies whether to save the linked picture with the document.
True - Save the linked picture with the document
False - Do not save the linked picture with the document (default)

parameters.name: $oRange
parameters.description:
[optional] The location where the picture will be placed in the text.
Can be 0 (the picture is placed automatically) or any range object (default = 0)

_word_docpictureadd.returnValue:
- Success: a variable pointing to the shape object
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oDoc is not an object
2 - The specified picture does not exist
3 - Error occurred when adding the specified picture. @extended is set to the COM error code
4 - $oRange is not 0 but is not a range object

_word_docprint.name: _Word_DocPrint
_word_docprint.summary: Prints all or parts of the specified document

parameters.name: $oDoc
parameters.description: Word document object

parameters.name: $bBackground
parameters.description: [optional] True lets the script continue while the document is printed (default = False)

parameters.name: $iCopies
parameters.description: [optional] The number of copies to be printed (default = 1)

parameters.name: $iOrientation
parameters.description:
[optional] Sets the orientation of the page:
-1 - Use current document orientation (default)
0 - Portrait ($WdOrientPortrait of the WdOrientation enumeration)
1 - Landscape ($WdOrientLandscape of the WdOrientation enumeration)

parameters.name: $bCollate
parameters.description: [optional] True prints all pages of the document before printing the next copy (default = True)

parameters.name: $sPrinter
parameters.description: [optional] Sets the name of the printer (default = "" = Active printer)

parameters.name: $iRange
parameters.description:
[optional] Specifies the page range to print.
Can be any of the WdPrintOutRange enumeration.
(default = $WdPrintAllDocument = print the entire document)

parameters.name: $vFrom
parameters.description: [optional] The starting page number (integer) when $iRange is set to $WdPrintFromTo

parameters.name: $vTo
parameters.description: [optional] The ending page number (integer) when $iRange is set to $WdPrintFromTo

parameters.name: $sPages
parameters.description:
[optional] The page numbers and page ranges to be printed, separated by commas when $iRange is set to 4.
For example, "2, 6-10" prints page 2 and pages 6 through 10 (default = "")

parameters.name: $iPageType
parameters.description:
[optional] The type of pages to be printed. Can be any of the WdPrintOutPages enumeration
(default = $WdPrintAllPages = print all pages)

parameters.name: $iItem
parameters.description:
[optional] The item to be printed. Can be any of the WdPrintOutItem enumeration
(default = $WdPrintDocumentContent = document content)

_word_docprint.returnValue:
- Success: 1.
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oDoc is not an object
2 - Error setting page orientation. @extended is set to the COM error code
3 - @error returned when setting the active printer to $sPrinter
4 - Error occurred when printing the file. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_docrangeset.name: _Word_DocRangeSet
_word_docrangeset.summary: Sets or modifies a range in a document

parameters.name: $oDoc
parameters.description: Word document object

parameters.name: $vRange
parameters.description:
Range to set or extend. You can pass an existing range which then is extended. Also valid is:
0 - uses the current selection as range
-1 - sets the range start/end at the start of the document
-2 - sets the range start/end at the end of the document

parameters.name: $iStartUnit
parameters.description:
[optional] Unit by/to which the start position of the range is to be moved/set.
Can be any of the WdUnit enumeration (default = $WdWord).
When set to -1 the range is collapsed to the start of the range

parameters.name: $iStartCount
parameters.description:
[optional] Number of units by/to which the start of range is moved/set.
Positive numbers move the range forward in the document.
If the position is moved forward to a position beyond the end position of the range, the range is collapsed
and both the start and end positions are moved together(default = don't move the start position)

parameters.name: $iEndUnit
parameters.description:
[optional] Unit by/to which the end position of the range is to be moved/set.
Can be any of the WdUnit enumeration (default = $WdWord).
When set to -1 the range is collapsed to the end of the range

parameters.name: $iEndCount
parameters.description:
[optional] Number of units by/to which the end of the range is moved/set.
If this number is negative, the end is moved backward.
If the ending position overtakes the starting position, the range
collapses and both positions move together (default = don't move the end position)

_word_docrangeset.returnValue:
- Success: the modified range object.
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oDoc is not an object
2 - $vRange has to be a range object, 0 or -1
3 - Error occurred when setting the start of the range. @extended is set to the COM error code
4 - Error occurred when setting the end of the range. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_docsave.name: _Word_DocSave

parameters.name: $oDoc
parameters.description: Word document object

_word_docsave.returnValue:
- Success: 1.
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oDoc is not an object
2 - The specified document has not been saved before, please use _Word_DocSaveAs() first
3 - Error occurred when saving the specified document. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_docsaveas.name: _Word_DocSaveAs
_word_docsaveas.summary: Saves the specified Word document with a new name or format

parameters.name: $oDoc
parameters.description: Word document object

parameters.name: $sFileName
parameters.description:
[optional] The full path name for the document (default = Current folder and current file name if the document has been saved before).
If the document has never been saved before, the default name is used and the document is saved in the MyDocuments folder e.g. "@MyDocumentsDir\Doc1.doc".

parameters.name: $iFileFormat
parameters.description:
[optional] The format in which the document is saved.
Can be any WdSaveFormat constant (default = $WdFormatDocument)

parameters.name: $bReadOnlyRecommended
parameters.description: [optional] True to have Word suggest read-only status whenever the document is opened (default = False)

parameters.name: $bAddToRecentFiles
parameters.description: [optional] True to add the document to the list of recently used files (default = True)

parameters.name: $sPassword
parameters.description: [optional] A password string for opening the document (default = "")

parameters.name: $sWritePassword
parameters.description: [optional] A password string for saving changes to the document (default = "")

_word_docsaveas.returnValue:
- Success: 1.
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oDoc is not an object
2 - Error occurred when saving the specified document. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_doctableread.name: _Word_DocTableRead
_word_doctableread.summary: Reads a Word table and returns the content as a two-dimensional array

parameters.name: $oDoc
parameters.description: Word document object

parameters.name: $vTable
parameters.description: Table object or index of the table in the table collection

parameters.name: $iIndexBase
parameters.description: [optional] Can be 0 or 1 and specifies if the array starts with row 0 or 1 (default = 1)

parameters.name: $sDelimiter
parameters.description: [optional] Specifies the character used to separate text into cells (default = @TAB)

_word_doctableread.returnValue:
- Success: Two-dimensional array with the content of the Word table.
- Failure: Empty string and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oDoc is not an object
2 - Error occurred when accessing the specified table index in the table collection. @extended is set to the COM error code
3 - Error occurred when accessing the specified table. @extended is set to the COM error code
4 - Error occurred when converting the text to a table. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_doctablewrite.name: _Word_DocTableWrite
_word_doctablewrite.summary: Writes a one or two dimensional array to a Word table

parameters.name: $oRange
parameters.description: Word range object where the table should be inserted

parameters.name: $aArray
parameters.description:
one or two-dimensional array to be converted to a table.
Can be zero or 1-based

parameters.name: $iIndexBase
parameters.description: [optional] Can be 0 or 1 and specifies if the array starts with row 0 or 1 (default = 1)

parameters.name: $sDelimiter
parameters.description: [optional] Specifies the character used to separate text into cells (default = @TAB)

_word_doctablewrite.returnValue:
- Success: the Word table object.
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oRange is not an object
2 - $aArray is not an array or has more than 2 dimensions
3 - Error occurred when accessing the specified range object. @extended is set to the COM error code
4 - Error occurred when converting the text to a table. @extended is set to the COM error code

_word_quit.name: _Word_Quit
_word_quit.summary: Closes all documents, the Word application and removes the object reference to it

parameters.name: $oAppl
parameters.description: Word object returned by a preceding call to _Word_Create()

parameters.name: $iSaveChanges
parameters.description:
[optional] Specifies if changed documents should be saved before closing.
Can be one of the WdSaveOptions enumeration (default = $WdDoNotSaveChanges)

parameters.name: $iOriginalFormat
parameters.description:
[optional] Specifies how Word saves documents whose original format was not Word document format.
Can be any of the WdOriginalFormat enumeration (default = $WdWordDocument)

parameters.name: $bForceClose
parameters.description: [optional] If True the Word application is closed even when it was running at _Word_Create() time (default = False)

_word_quit.returnValue:
- Success: 1.
- Failure: 0 and sets the @error flag to non-zero.
- @error: 1 - $oAppl is not an object
2 - Error returned by method Application.Quit. @extended is set to the COM error code
